issue.body:
## Summary

- **Fix broken `index.html`** — a second UI (Green Miracle 2085) had been injected directly inside JavaScript functions, making the file syntactically invalid. Restored the single Autonomous Alpha Console dashboard with all JS intact and auto-connect on load.
- **Fix `docker-compose.yaml`** — removed duplicate `volumes:` key and malformed `environment:` block; added `healthcheck` dependency so Caddy only starts after the backend is healthy.
- **Implement four core stub modules** — `hypothesis_engine`, `evaluation_engine`, `feature_engine`, and `approval_gate` were all 1-line stubs. All four are now fully implemented with real business logic, persistence, and type safety.
- **Harden `backend.py`** — Pydantic request models, `slowapi` rate limiting (30/10/20 req/min per endpoint), optional `API_KEY` header guard, structured JSON logging, FastAPI `lifespan` context manager (replaces deprecated `on_event`), graceful SIGTERM/SIGINT handling, richer `/health` response.
- **Harden `Dockerfile`** — multi-stage build (deps → runtime), non-root `appuser`, `HEALTHCHECK` directive, `.dockerignore` to exclude dev artefacts.
- **Pin dependencies** — `requirements.txt` now has upper-bound pins; added `requirements-dev.txt` (pytest, httpx, ruff).
- **Add `.env.example`** — documents all 10+ environment variables with descriptions.
- **Add pytest suite** — 34 tests across `edge_math`, all four core modules, and FastAPI HTTP endpoints. All green.
- **Add CI workflows** — `test.yml` (ruff lint + pytest on every push/PR), `docker.yml` (build + container smoke test).
- **Wire Vercel** — `vercel.json` serves `index.html` + static artefacts. Dashboard auto-detects backend origin (same-origin, `?api=` param, or `BACKEND_URL` env var) so https://overaj.vercel.app connects to any deployed backend automatically.

## Test plan

- [ ] `pip install -r requirements-dev.txt && pytest` — should show 34 passed
- [ ] `docker compose up --build` — backend healthy on :8765, dashboard on :8080
- [ ] Visit https://overaj.vercel.app — dashboard connects via `?api=<backend-url>` query param
- [ ] `GET /health` returns `{"status":"ok","uptime_seconds":...}`
- [ ] `POST /scan` returns signals payload; `POST /scan {"persist":true}` also updates `signals.json`
- [ ] `POST /focus` returns entropy + targets
- [ ] WebSocket `/ws` responds to `{type:"scan"}` and `{type:"focus"}`
